correctness.rationale: For all positive even k, the Pell addition identity reduces infinite all-translate gcds to gcd(first window,48 B_k) and gcd(first window,6 B_k), with exact strong-divisibility proof. The first-window formulas give odd-prime parts for p not 3. A local 3-adic lifting of (17±12sqrt(2))^m yields v3(B_k)=v3(k)+1, so the extra 3 in the increment gcd does not contribute. The finite binomial formulas for P_(2k)/(2k) and C_k establish the 2-adic unit residues mod 16, yielding valuations v2(k) for Lucas-balancing square sums and v2(k)-1 for balancing square sums. All prime cases are covered. Exact integer verifier checks 20,000 windows, but finite evidence is not the universal proof.
